observations: Two photos show a single solar panel standing vertically, leaning against a wall.
The panel has a grid of dark, rectangular solar cells arranged in a hexagonal pattern with white gaps between them.
The frame is black and appears to be made of metal or plastic.
The panel is in a storage or workshop environment with concrete floor and other panels visible in the background.
Watermark 'DON KACHI SOLAR ENERGY' is overlaid on both photos.
No brand name, model number, or specifications are visible on the panel itself.
No signs of damage or wear are visible in the photos, but the surface appears slightly dusty or smudged.
